There are many '''weapons''' in the multiplayer of ''Red Dead Redemption''. They can be unlocked by [[Red Dead Redemption/Ranks|ranking up]].

== Pistols and Revolvers ==

=== Cattleman Revolver ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 1.

The '''Cattleman Revolver''' is a general-purpose revolver available to the player from the start of multiplayer.

=== Volcanic Pistol ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 5.

The '''Volcanic Pistol''' is a pistol available to a player at Rank 5. It is a fairly weak pistol compared to others, and has a low fire rate, but causes sufficient damage to be able to kill enemies in two or three shots.

=== Schofield Revolver ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 9.

The '''Schofield Revolver''' is a single-action six-shot revolver, available to a player from Rank 9. It fires a powerful .45 round and is effective at killing enemies quickly.

=== Double-Action Revolver ===

The '''Double-Action Revolver''' is a revolver available at Rank 17. It can fire at a much faster rate than a standard revolver, but at a reduced accuracy. It has a medium clip-size.

=== High Power Pistol ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 35.

=== LeMat Revolver ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 46.

=== Mauser Pistol ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 49.

== Projectiles ==

=== Dynamite ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 15.

'''Dynamite''' is an explosive available to the player from Rank 15. A player can carry a maximum of two sticks at a time. When using dynamite, the fuse is automatically lit whilst the player is aiming the projectile, leaving it prone to explode in the player's hand if it is not thrown within a time limit. It has a moderate blast radius and is useful for killing many enemies in one place, for example those entering through a door.

=== Fire Bottle ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 22.

'''Fire Bottles''' are projectiles which explode into flames on impact. They are unlocked to a player at Rank 22, and a player can carry a maximum of two of them at a time. They do not kill a player, instead knocking them to the floor for several seconds and reducing health. They are often used by reinforcement NPCs when clearing a gang hideout.

=== Throwing Knife ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 3.

'''Throwing Knives''' are available to the player from Rank 3. They are small knives which can kill a player in two hits. A player can carry twenty of them at a time.

*'''Rank unlocked at''': 37.

== Rifles ==

Rifles are single-shot weapons which are fairly accurate and have moderate range.

=== Repeater Carbine ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 2.

The '''Repeater Carbine''' is the first rifle the player unlocks in multiplayer mode, at Rank 2. It is a short rifle which is effective when the player is on horseback.

=== Winchester Repeater ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 8.

The '''Winchester Repeater''' is a reliable rifle which the player unlocks in multiplayer at Rank 8.

=== Springfield Rifle ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 13.

The '''Springfield Rifle''' is a highly accurate and powerful rifle which is effective at a medium to long range. It is unlocked to the player at Rank 13, but it can also be gained by playing the [[Red Dead Redemption/Hideouts#Gaptooth Breach|Gaptooth Breach hideout]]. It is often used by NPCs from towers and cliffs where it can be extremely deadly.

=== Henry Repeater ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 32.

=== Evans Repeater ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 43.

=== Hunting Knife ===
*'''Rank unlocked at''': 1.

The '''Hunting Knife''' is a melee weapon available from the start of multiplayer. It inflicts major damage to animals and can be used in combat to seriously damage another player.
